mentions.name: Daino Qt
mentions.description: A collection of UI components that makes Qt apps feel and look native on both desktops and mobiles, bridging the gaps in the built-in Qt Quick components.
mentions.problem: Built-in Qt Quick components fall short on mobile, with issues like non-native text handling, a non-native swipe-able stack view, and components that don't behave or look like those of the platforms Qt apps run on.
mentions.audience: Qt app developers building with C++ and QML
mentions.source_excerpt: Creating Daino Qt - a collection of components that makes Qt apps feel and look native on both Desktops and mobiles (each with its own set of challenges).
